name: Contractbook
description_en:
Contractbook combines contract drafting, collaboration and signing with a searchable contract repository and AI-assisted data extraction. An imported agreement can become structured contract information used for views, reminders and follow-up work, rather than remaining only a stored PDF.

The current pricing page distinguishes Essential, Centralize and Accelerate, with different users, templates and annual signed-contract allowances. Workflow automation, identity provisioning and integrations are not interchangeable across these packages. This profile treats the extracted price table cautiously because the page exposes multiple currencies and inconsistent historical amounts in its text.
description_zh:
Contractbook 将合同起草、协作和签署，与可搜索合同库及 AI 信息提取结合。导入的协议可转成结构化信息，用于视图、提醒和后续工作，而不只是保存一份 PDF。

当前定价页区分 Essential、Centralize 和 Accelerate，用户数、模板数及每年签署合同额度不同。自动化、身份配置和集成在套餐间并不相同。读取文本同时出现多币种及不一致的历史金额，因此本文谨慎处理价格表。

sections.title_en: Turn a signed PDF into a renewal record
sections.title_zh: 把已签 PDF 转成续约记录
sections.en:
For an existing supplier PDF, import the agreement, inspect extracted names and dates, add missing metadata and save a view of upcoming renewals. The Centralize product page explicitly includes verifying and enriching AI-generated information. Use the cancellation-notice date where that differs from expiry.

As an evaluation example, compare the extracted renewal field with both the original agreement and an amendment. A populated date is not evidence that the legally controlling date was selected. No files were uploaded in this research.
sections.zh:
对现有供应商 PDF，可导入协议，检查提取的名称和日期，补充缺失元数据，再保存即将续约的视图。Centralize 产品页明确包含复核与补充 AI 信息的步骤。取消通知日期与到期日不同时，应使用符合业务目的的日期。

评估时可将提取字段同时与原协议和补充协议核对。字段有值，并不证明选中了法律上有效的日期。本文未上传文件。

sections.title_en: Signature is one stage of the contract lifecycle
sections.title_zh: 签署只是合同生命周期的一个阶段
sections.en:
The product supports templates, shared drafts and signing, while the pricing FAQ says external recipients do not need a Contractbook account to complete their signature action. A team still needs an approved template, correct parties and a decision about who may alter terms.

Do not confuse an external signer with an internal paid user. Plan the preparation and approval roles separately from the recipient’s signing experience, and check the applicable signature method for the transaction.
sections.zh:
产品支持模板、共享草稿和签署；定价 FAQ 说明外部收件人完成签署动作不需要 Contractbook 账户。团队仍需准备批准模板、正确的签约方，并确定谁可以修改条款。

外部签署人不能与内部付费用户混为一谈。应分别规划准备、审批角色及收件人签署体验，并核对具体交易适用的签署方式。

sections.title_en: Count signed contracts, users and uploads separately
sections.title_zh: 分别计算签署合同、用户和导入额度
sections.en: The retrieved package cards list Essential with one user, five templates and 100 signed contracts per year; Centralize with five users, 15 templates and 350; Accelerate with ten users, 25 templates and 500. These are annual signed-contract allowances, not monthly signature counts. The cards also show upload allowances, while older table text conflicts on whether some uploads are unlimited. Confirm the operative allowance before migration.
sections.zh: 读取的套餐卡片列出：Essential 含 1 用户、5 模板和每年 100 份签署合同；Centralize 为 5 用户、15 模板和 350 份；Accelerate 为 10 用户、25 模板和 500 份。这是年度签署合同额度，不是月度签名次数。卡片另列导入额度，但旧表格文本对部分导入是否无限存在冲突，迁移前需确认实际权益。

sections.title_en: Check automation and API add-ons before designing the handoff
sections.title_zh: 设计交接前核对自动化与 API 附加项
sections.en: The pricing page identifies Automations as available for Centralize and included in Accelerate. API access, Zapier and Make access have their own availability and add-on treatment; the API note mentions fair-use limits. An integration listed on the website therefore does not establish that it is included in the entry plan or that arbitrary API volume is allowed. Ask for the required package and the exact operation before connecting production systems.
sections.zh: 定价页把 Automations 标为 Centralize 可选、Accelerate 包含。API、Zapier 和 Make 访问另有套餐及附加项条件，API 还注明公平使用限制。因此，网站列有集成，不表示入门版包含它，也不表示 API 调用量任意。连接生产系统前，应核对所需套餐和具体操作。

sections.title_en: Why this profile leaves the payable amount unknown
sections.title_zh: 为何本文保留应付金额未知
sections.en: The page offers quotes for Centralize and Accelerate and exposes annual-billing language, a 14-day no-card trial and a limited free plan after trial. Its extracted text also includes multiple currency options and conflicting amounts in several tables. We do not choose one hidden or historical number as a verified payable price. Request a dated quote identifying currency, annual commitment, seats, signed-contract allowance and add-ons. Limited post-trial access should not be assumed to retain trial automation or AI entitlements.
sections.zh: 页面对 Centralize、Accelerate 提供询价，并说明年付、14 天免信用卡试用及试用后有限免费版。读取文本还包含多币种选项和多张表中冲突的金额。本文不会挑一个隐藏或历史数字当作已核实应付价。应取得注明币种、年度承诺、席位、签署合同额度及附加项的当日报价。试用后的有限访问，也不能假定保留试用中的自动化或 AI 权益。

sections.title_en: Use it when contract information must remain actionable
sections.title_zh: 适合合同信息需要持续驱动工作的团队
sections.en: Contractbook is relevant when agreements must be created and signed and later searched, assigned and tracked. A team needing only occasional signatures may have little use for the repository configuration or higher-tier workflows. Begin with a small PDF set, template, owner and reminder rule. This is a hosted application evaluation; no self-hosted installation or open-source licence was verified. Exact failure recovery, data location and export completeness require further checks.
sections.zh: 当协议既要创建、签署，又要在之后持续搜索、分配和跟踪时，Contractbook 值得评估。仅偶尔签署的团队，可能用不到合同库配置或高阶流程。可从少量 PDF、一份模板、一位负责人及一条提醒规则开始。本文评估的是托管应用，未核实自托管安装或开源许可；具体故障恢复、数据位置和导出完整性仍需核查。
